units.source_text: 无疑，千重子隐隐约约觉察到真一在爱她。

en.t: Without a doubt, Chieko had faintly sensed that Shinichi was in love with her.

units.source_text: 她的告白，也许是为了让自己爱着的人了解自己的身世。

en.t: Perhaps her confession was meant to let the person she loved understand the circumstances of her birth.
But Shinichi could not hear it that way.

units.source_text: 相反，他感到她的话音里有拒绝他的爱的含意。

en.t: On the contrary, he felt that the tone of her words carried the meaning of rejecting his love.

units.source_text: 纵然“弃儿”这话出自千重子的编造也罢……

en.t: Even if the word "abandoned child" had come from something Chieko had made up...
